title: [dev] Missing BG Value Upload
symptom: In AAPS 3.1.0.3-dev-e, the option to upload BG values to Nightscout has disappeared from the Nightscout configuration menu. Users report that with certain BG sources (e.g., xDrip, Juggluco via xDrip broadcast), the preference menu is disabled and BG values are not uploaded to Nightscout.
cause: The option was removed from the Nightscout configuration because it is not available for all BG sources. xDrip is treated as a BG source with upload capability, so the option is missing in AAPS for xDrip and similar sources.
fix: For users not using xDrip but using Juggluco, the suggested workaround is to install xDrip to receive the data and upload it, or ask Juggluco developers to create a special broadcast to AAPS. No direct fix within AAPS is provided.
evidence_quote: it's in BG source preferences. The reason of removal from here was this feature is not available for all bg sources
